labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks when pull requests will be enabled for external contributors, which is contribution process and is answered by CONTRIBUTING.md and AI_POLICY.md.

items.body:
Pull requests from outside the collaborator group are not open here: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) asks contributors to describe the change in an issue first, and a maintainer decides from there. Please read [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) too, since it covers AI-assisted changes. For a broken link in the docs, opening an issue that names the link is the right first step. A related earlier discussion is #4029. For questions about the process, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the place to ask.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
